body:
**WARNING:** Comment overclaims facade routing — `bro next` and `bro loop` call the beads-backed `taskStore()` directly (`packages/cli/src/commands/next.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/loop.ts`) and never resolve through `facade('tasks', …)`; only the `bro task` doc verbs do (`packages/cli/src/doctypes/task.ts`). As written, a reader would expect `connectors.tasks` to retarget `next`/`loop`, but it only affects the `bro task` surface.

```suggestion
  tasks?(ctx): TaskStore            // work items — the `bro task` doc surface
```

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
